t: What he said standing up to pray
a: فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
p: Fa-ghfir lī dhunūbī jamīʿan innahu lā yaghfiru-dh-dhunūba illā ant, wa-hdinī li-aḥsani-l-akhlāq, lā yahdī li-aḥsanihā illā ant
m: So forgive me all my sins. None forgives sins but You. And guide me to the best of characters. None guides to the best of them but You.
